subject: what truecap actually is
preheader: a 60-second rental underwriter built around the numbers lenders actually check.
headline: TrueCap is the rental underwriter I wished existed when I was buying deals.
body: Most rental analysis tools fall into two camps. Either they're glorified rent calculators that ignore taxes, insurance, vacancy, and PM fees. Or they're 47-tab spreadsheets that take half an hour and still get DSCR wrong because the formula was copied from a forum in 2014.

TrueCap is the middle path. Paste any U.S. address. In 60 seconds you get cap rate, cash-on-cash, DSCR, NOI, full operating expense breakdown, and a plain-English verdict — Strong, Solid, Mixed, Marginal, or Negative. The math matches what a lender's underwriter would do, not what a guru's course tells you.

The philosophy is simple. Speed changes which deals you find. If underwriting takes 30 minutes you'll evaluate 10 listings a week. If it takes 60 seconds you'll evaluate 100. The investors winning right now aren't smarter. They're just looking at twenty times more surface area.

Free tier is genuinely free. No card, no trial timer, unlimited basic analyses. Pro is $29.99/mo and adds 10-year projections, MAO calculator, sensitivity grids, BRRRR analyzer, flip analyzer, PDF reports, and saved deal history. Most people start free and stay free for a while.
If you've never tried it, pick the next listing in your inbox and paste the address. You'll know within 60 seconds whether this is built for the way you actually work.
